svg.aria-label: os-xgs-npu status. Stage: discovery, front ports and offload done; integration and testing in progress; the repository notice not yet lifted. XGS 3300, Cavium OCTEON TX: 12 of 12 front ports and the module's, flow offload with 99.6 per cent of frames in hardware, IPsec offload with GCM, CBC, NAT-T and IPv6, best IPsec measured here 7.41 Gbit/s on one stream while the vendor rates the appliance at 31.1 Gbit/s across many tunnels, sensors, front panel and first boot, a built image booted from disk, weighted completion 92 per cent. XGS 136, Marvell CN9131: 14 of 14 front ports, flow offload by the sweep, IPsec offload with GCM, CBC and NAT-T, best IPsec measured here 982 Mbit/s over one gigabit link while the vendor rates it at 4.8 Gbit/s across many tunnels, first boot by the chassis names, integration in progress, not weighed yet. OCTEON TX2 and TX2 98XX described only; TOPAZ and GR have no coprocessor. 2,391 GiB over TLS with no byte changed; 6,100 give-backs revived, none refused; ten claims withdrawn and nineteen dead ends recorded. Vendor figures come from its datasheets under lab load across many tunnels; the figures measured here are one TCP stream ending on the appliance host.

“What is left is engineering rather than discovery.”
